title: Wolfi's Random Ahh Mod
description: A mod that adds a lot different items and references to your world
body:
## What is this mod even about?
Since I got tired of thinking about a super duper cool and 100% related name, I just went along with this lol :p

This mod adds **130+ items** to your world, which includes new tools, ingots, consumeables and other materials.

**+ EASTER SPECIAL!** Obtain Easter Eggs from a certain mob...

Some items require grinding to be obtained.

Could be considered a tryhard mod(?)

_The mod includes references from different games etc._
